name: webcam-screen
title: Printer Screen as Camera
author: bespoked
description: Registers the framebuffer mirror from the Remote Screen plugin as a Moonraker [webcam] iframe entry, so Fluidd and Mainsail show the printer's touchscreen alongside other cameras. Aspect ratio fixed at 480:320 for the U1's screen. Requires the Remote Screen plugin to actually serve /screen/.
tagline: Show the on-device touchscreen as a camera tile in Fluidd & Mainsail.

variables.name: REMOTE_SCREEN_NAME
variables.description: Display name for the on-device screen mirror in Fluidd/Mainsail (e.g. "Screen", "Printer Screen", "UI").
